Environment 27 Mar 2025

SUPPORTING OUR WOMEN SECTOR

A heartfelt thank you to our dedicated women leaders for the opportunity to be part of today’s Educational, Entrepreneurial, and Environmental Benchmarking in Kabankalan City. Alongside Kons. Nity Sta Ana Bartolome, Kons. Hermie Millan, Mam Jems Silab-Reunir, and Ms. Lara Ann Garcia, we engaged in meaningful discussions and firsthand experiences that reinforce the importance of empowering women in various fields.

We reflected on the wisdom of the saying: “Give a man a fish, and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish, and you feed him for a lifetime.” This principle came to life through the skills training program facilitated by the partnership between the Local Government Unit (LGU) and TESDA.

Such initiatives provide women and communities with sustainable livelihood opportunities, allowing them to achieve self-sufficiency and long-term financial stability.

Beyond entrepreneurship, we also gained valuable insights into sanitary landfill operations and efficient waste management systems. Seeing firsthand how Kabankalan manages its environmental responsibilities highlighted the crucial role of proper waste disposal in maintaining a cleaner and healthier community—an initiative that aligns with the broader goal of environmental sustainability.

Perhaps the most inspiring aspect of the visit was witnessing the various livelihood programs tailored for women. These programs reaffirm that empowerment is key to progress—when women are given the right tools, resources, and support, they become drivers of economic growth and social development.

With this enriching experience, I am confident that our women sector is well-equipped to embrace new opportunities and build a brighter, more inclusive future. We are grateful for the support of Mayor Javier Lopez Benitez, Vice Mayor Junb Bantug, and City Administrator Atty. Lindolf de Castro, whose leadership and commitment made this initiative possible as part of the Women’s Month Celebration.

Congratulations to everyone who contributed to this successful and impactful activity. May we continue working together to uplift and empower our women.

God bless, and more power to all!

March 26, 2025 – Kabankalan City
